title: Pauli-matrix completeness / SU(2) Fierz generator relation
expression_sketch: Explicit generators: sigma_1 = [[0,1],[1,0]], sigma_2 = [[0,-I],[I,0]], sigma_3 = [[1,0],[0,-1]], sigma_0 = [[1,0],[0,1]].  Product law: sigma_i*sigma_j = delta(i,j)*sigma_0 + I*epsilon(i,j,k)*sigma_k for i,j,k in {1,2,3}.  Completeness (spinor indices alpha,beta,gamma,delta in {1,2}): Sum_{k=1}^{3} sigma_k(alpha,beta)*sigma_k(gamma,delta) == 2*delta(alpha,delta)*delta(beta,gamma) - delta(alpha,beta)*delta(gamma,delta).  Including identity: Sum_{k=0}^{3} sigma_k(alpha,beta)*sigma_k(gamma,delta) == 2*delta(alpha,delta)*delta(beta,gamma).  Trace form of the same reconstruction: 2*M(alpha,beta) = delta(alpha,beta)*Tr(M) + Sum_k sigma_k(alpha,beta)*Tr(sigma_k*M).
latent_structure: Tensor generators of su(2)/Hermitian 2x2 matrices: the Pauli basis reconstructs the index-swap operator (Fierz) as an invariant bilinear in the generators. Completeness is a BASIS_RECONSTRUCTION obligation, not a dummy-index rename.

function_domains.sigma: The three Pauli matrices plus optional sigma_0=Id as explicit 2x2 complex matrices (Wikipedia Pauli matrices).
function_domains.delta: Kronecker delta on the indicated finite index set.

source_provenance: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pauli_matrices (product law; completeness relation with spinor indices)
C. C. Nishi, Simple derivation of general Fierz-type identities, hep-ph/0408004, eq. (20)

derived_conditions.statement: sigma_k are traceless Hermitian involutions: Tr(sigma_k)=0, sigma_k**2 = Id for k=1,2,3.
derived_conditions.label: DECLARED

derived_conditions.statement: The four matrices {sigma_0,...,sigma_3} are a C-basis of M_2(C) and an R-basis of Hermitian 2x2 matrices.
derived_conditions.label: DECLARED
derived_conditions.source: Wikipedia Pauli matrices, Hilbert-Schmidt basis paragraph

derived_conditions.statement: Completeness is the component form of M = (1/2)Tr(M) Id + (1/2) Sum_k Tr(sigma_k M) sigma_k.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

public_source: Wikipedia Pauli matrices completeness; Nishi hep-ph/0408004 eq. (20)
why_not_cse_lgg: The left-hand side is a sum of three Kronecker products of Pauli components; the right-hand side is a linear combination of Kronecker deltas on swapped spinor indices. CSE cannot invent the su(2) generator basis. LGG has no 2x2 matrix-algebra constructor.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide Fierz, completeness, su(2), Clifford, quaternion. Do not name Pauli in the proposer-visible catalog if the gold is the swap reconstruction.
notes: Finite matrix identity over C. No quantum-mechanical interpretation is required for verification. sigma_y uses the imaginary unit; that is in the explicit matrix, not an undeclared branch.
